name: ICRA Limited

annual_report.business: ICRA Limited is a credit rating agency that provides ratings, research, analytics, and ESG ratings, operating as a knowledge partner and risk navigator for financial markets.

guidance_or_targets.statement: ICRA pegs the WPI at ~6.6% and the CPI at ~4.7% in FY2027, with risks tilted to the upside. ICRA expects an extended pause on the policy rates in the near term, followed by back-ended rate hikes towards the end of the fiscal, amid the anticipated slowdown in GDP growth.
